rules: Install dishka-fastmcp and import dishka_fastmcp; it is a different package from fastmcp-dishka (import fastmcp_dishka).
Put @inject below @mcp.tool, @mcp.resource or @mcp.prompt, so FromDishka parameters stay out of the tool schema; the other order raises DishkaFastMCPError at import.
Async handlers need make_async_container; sync handlers need make_container. One server's injected handlers share one kind.
Pass dishka_lifespan(container) to FastMCP(lifespan=...) and call setup_dishka(container, mcp) once per server that owns a container.

Scope.SESSION needs DishkaMiddleware(session_scope=True) and spans requests only on 2025 handshake connections; 2026-07-28 and stateless HTTP connections live one request. Over stateful HTTP set session_idle_timeout, or abandoned sessions keep SESSION dependencies until restart.
When the container is shared with FastAPI or FastStream, list the MCP lifespan first in combine_lifespans or pass finalize_container=False.
Return completed values from handlers; task=True handlers cannot use FromDishka.
For REQUEST dependencies outside handlers, add DishkaMiddleware() first and resolve with await get_request_container().get(T).
